filterUntranslated.note: Short filter-chip label meaning 'not yet translated'. Prefer a natural UI phrase (pl: 'bez tłumaczenia'), never an English calque like 'nietranslateowane'.

modalAdd.note: Button: add a locale and enqueue a translation job. 'queue' means task queue / warteschlange / kolejka — never encrypt/cipher.

keepToast.note: Toast after marking a string as intentionally left untranslated.
